test_title: PYST 5: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held on: 26 Oct 2023)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

He said, “I bought this book for my brother.”

options.text: He said that he buy this book for his brother.
He said that he had bought that book for his brother.
He said that he has bought this book for his brother.
He said that he bought this book for his brother.

solution:
The correct answer is: **He said that he had bought that book for his brother.**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The sentence in the Direct Speech is in the **Past Simple Tense**.
 
• When converting a sentence from Direct Speech to Indirect Speech, the Past Simple Tense changes to **Past Perfect Tense**.
 
• The following changes occur when transforming the sentence:
 
• **This** changes to **that**.

 
 

 **Direct Speech**
 **Indirect Speech**
 
 

 I bought this book for my brother.
 he had bought that book for his brother.
 
 

 He said,
 He said that
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: ***He said that he had bought that book for his brother**.*
